findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "cc.list_catalog" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List Central Command x402 catalog endpoints (names, prices, parameters, tiers). Purpose: discover which cc.* tools exist and what they cost before calling them.…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cc.squirrel_chat, cc.market_news, cc.data_tools, cc.auto_fetch_market_data, cc.strategy_backtest, cc.strategy_data_parser · Private data: cc.squirrel_chat, cc.openclaw_chat, cc.indicator_generator, cc.blofin_public, cc.twap_executor, cc.trade_builder, cc.asset_scanner, cc.fear_greed, cc.etf_flows, cc.economic_calendar, cc.market_news, cc.coinglass_data, cc.funding_rates, cc.open_interest, cc.ma_fetch, cc.traditional_markets, cc.cme_gap, cc.central_signal, cc.external_signal, cc.data_tools, cc.auto_fetch_market_data, cc.strategy_backtest, cc.strategy_data_parser, cc.wallet_browser_proxy, cc.solana_rpc · Public sink: cc.trade_builder, cc.central_signal, cc.external_signal, cc.wallet_browser_proxy, cc.solana_rpc · Destructive: cc.agent_strategy, cc.openclaw_chat, cc.twap_executor, cc.trade_builder, cc.central_signal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cc.squirrel_chat, cc.market_news, cc.data_tools, cc.auto_fetch_market_data, cc.strategy_backtest, cc.strategy_data_parser · Private data: cc.squirrel_chat, cc.openclaw_chat, cc.indicator_generator, cc.blofin_public, cc.twap_executor, cc.trade_builder, cc.asset_scanner, cc.fear_greed, cc.etf_flows, cc.economic_calendar, cc.market_news, cc.coinglass_data, cc.funding_rates, cc.open_interest, cc.ma_fetch, cc.traditional_markets, cc.cme_gap, cc.central_signal, cc.external_signal, cc.data_tools, cc.auto_fetch_market_data, cc.strategy_backtest, cc.strategy_data_parser, cc.wallet_browser_proxy, cc.solana_rpc · Public sink: cc.trade_builder, cc.central_signal, cc.external_signal, cc.wallet_browser_proxy, cc.solana_rpc · Destructive: cc.agent_strategy, cc.openclaw_chat, cc.twap_executor, cc.trade_builder, cc.central_signal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
